title: 第24章出发青阳县
novel_title: 莫欺老年穷，一天增加一个天赋点
content_zh:
陈安缓缓摊开手掌，感受着指尖那股仿佛无坚不摧的锋锐之力，心中有了清晰的判断。

    如今的他，若是再对上阿三、阿四那样的气血狼烟境武者，根本无需用拳。

    只需一招撕云手。

    便能在一瞬间，洞穿他们引以为傲的护体气血，像撕开一张薄纸般，轻易撕碎他们的心脏！

    感受着自身实力的提升，陈安的嘴角也是泛起了一抹弧度。

    旋即，陈安的心念微微一动，系统面板随之而出现在了陈安的视野之中。

    【宿主：陈安】

    【悟性：15】

    【评价：哟，文秀才来了！】

    【根骨：76】

    【评价：根骨不俗，你有武举人之资！】

    【天赋点：0】

    “根骨七十六了，再有不到一个月的时间，根骨就能够提升至一百！”

    陈安看着眼前的系统面板，脸上露出了一抹笑容。

    ……

    与此同时，风云镖局。

    演武场上，人声鼎沸。

    一队由二十名精锐趟子手组成的镖队已经集结完毕，个个精神抖擞，气势不凡。

    秦虎站在队伍最前方，满脸骄傲，蒲扇般的大手重重地拍在林枫的肩膀上，声音洪亮如钟：“枫儿，此行，你是主心骨！记住，万事以稳妥为先，镖在人在！”

    他又转过身，看着身旁眼眶微红的秦婉儿，虎目之中难得地流露出一丝柔情，但语气依旧沉稳：“婉儿，江湖险恶，不比在家里。此行一切都要听林枫师兄的安排，多看，多学，不可任性！”

    “知道了，爹爹……”

    秦婉儿委屈地咬着嘴唇，最终只能不情不愿地点了点头。
content_en:
Chen An slowly opened his palms, feeling the seemingly indestructible sharp force at his fingertips, and made a clear judgment in his heart.

    Now, if he faced Qi-Blood Wolf Smoke Realm warriors like Ah San and Ah Si, he would not need to use fists at all.

    All it takes is one move to tear away the clouds.

    In an instant, he can pierce through their proud body-protecting energy and blood, and easily tear their hearts apart like tearing through a piece of tissue paper!

    Feeling the improvement in his own strength, Chen An's mouth also curved.

    Immediately, Chen An's mind moved slightly, and the system panel appeared in Chen An's field of vision.

    [Host: Chen An]

    【Comprehension: 15】

    [Evaluation: Oh, Wen Xiucai is here! 】

    【Root bone: 76】

    [Evaluation: You have good character, you have the talent to be a martial artist! 】

    [Talent points: 0]

    "The root bone is seventy-six. In less than a month, the root bone will be raised to one hundred!"

    Chen An looked at the system panel in front of him with a smile on his face.

    …

    At the same time, Fengyun Escort Bureau.

    The martial arts arena was filled with people.

    A team of twenty elite escorts has been assembled, all of them are energetic and impressive.

    Qin Hu stood at the front of the team, his face full of pride, and his big hand like a cattail leaf slapped Lin Feng's shoulder heavily. His voice was as loud as a bell: "Feng'er, you are the backbone of this trip! Remember, safety comes first in everything, and the escort is always there!"

    He turned around again and looked at Qin Wan'er, who had reddish eyes next to him. There was a rare tenderness in his eyes, but his tone was still calm: "Wan'er, the world is not as dangerous as it is at home. Everything on this trip must be arranged by Senior Brother Lin Feng. Watch more, learn more, and don't be willful!"

    "I know, daddy..."

    Qin Wan'er bit her lip in embarrassment and finally nodded reluctantly.
